subject: Partner Center referral: Contoso account mapping & field routing

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Partner Center referral: Contoso account mapping & field routing

Asha / Partner Ops team —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As we discussed, we want to make Partner Center referrals for Contoso flow to the right field sellers at Contoso and also ensure our Partner Center intake maps consistently to your internal owner model. To kick this off I attached a workbook (PC_Mapping_Workbook_v1.xlsx) with three sheets: 1) proposed mapping rules, 2) tenant-to-account sample, 3) open questions.

Key asks:
- Can you confirm the account owner column we should use from your export (Partner Center owner vs. Contoso field-owner email)?
- For accounts with multiple historical owners, do you prefer "last-touch wins" or a territory-based rule?
- Please share Partner Center referral IDs for any high-priority accounts (enterprise logos) so we can pin routing.

Proposed default rule (for discussion):
1) If Partner Center owner email matches a Contoso field rep in the roster, route directly to that rep.
2) Else, map by territory (country + revenue band) to the regional AE pool.
3) If still unmatched, route to Contoso Partner Ops queue for manual claim.

Can you get back with a sample export by EOD Wed? We want to lock the initial routing rules before we enable automated handoffs next week.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PC_Mapping_Workbook_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Asha Menon <asha@contoso.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Contoso Partner Ops <partnerops@contoso.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral: Contoso account mapping & field routing

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear notes and workbook. We've pulled a first-pass export and attached Contoso_Accounts_FirstPass.csv. A few quick notes:
- Our Partner Center owner column is "pc_owner_email"; however, many legacy referrals still point to a centralized channel address (partnerops@contoso.com).
- For strategic accounts (> $1M ARR) we prefer manual assignment even if pc_owner_email exists.
- NorthStar Inc. is currently split across two AEs depending on product line; we'll flag as an exception.

Question: when you say "pin routing by tenant ID," do you mean single-tenant mappings (Office tenant GUID) or the Partner Center customer ID? We can provide either but the GUID is more reliable for duplicates.

Attached: Contoso_Accounts_FirstPass.csv (csv stub)

Subject: Re: Partner Center referral: Contoso account mapping & field routing

Team —

Reviewing Asha's export. A couple of practical suggestions we should adopt for the automated mapping service: 

1) Primary match order: (a) Partner Center customer ID -> field owner; (b) Office tenant GUID -> customer record match; (c) email domain heuristics -> territory owner.
2) For accounts flagged as strategic (> $1M) always require manual Partner Ops approval before an automatic claim. We'll surface these in the webhook payload with a "manual_claim": true flag.
3) Conflict resolution: if pc_owner_email != field_owner_email AND both are present, route a claim to the field_owner_email and CC partnerops@contoso.com; set a 48-hour auto-escalation to the regional manager.
4) Sync cadence: export from Contoso nightly; our intake service will reconcile once per hour; final owner change events pushed to HubSpot via HS-987654.

I've also drafted a short doc (Routing_Rules_v1.md) with pseudocode for the matching logic. Attaching that and will drop a copy into the shared drive after we finalize.

Thoughts?

-karthik
Partner Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Vanessa —

This looks reasonable. A few clarifications from the field: 
- Use Office tenant GUID (when available) as the canonical match for duplicate corporate tenants. Contoso's PC customer ID is ok but we've seen re-registrations cause mismatches.
- For the NorthStar Inc. split I suggest assigning primary ownership to Marcus for the initial outreach; product-specific handoffs can be coordinated after the first call.
- The 48-hour auto-escalation is fine but let's ensure the escalation includes the last three touch notes so the new AE has context.

Marcus — can you take NorthStar and confirm once outreach is complete?

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Field GTM
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Partner Center referral: Contoso account mapping & field routing

Asha / team —

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Summary and agreed actions: 

1) Canonical match: Office tenant GUID (when provided) will be primary. Partner Center customer ID will be used as a secondary key.
2) Strategic accounts (> $1M ARR) require manual claim via Contoso Partner Ops prior to auto-claim. We'll surface a manual_claim flag in the payload.
3) Conflict resolution: route to field_owner_email and CC partnerops@contoso.com with a 48-hour auto-escalation to the regional manager if unclaimed. Include last three touch notes in the escalation.
4) Sync: Contoso provides nightly export; Redwood intake reconciles hourly and pushes owners to HubSpot HS-987654.
5) NorthStar Inc.: Marcus to own initial outreach; Marcus will confirm status by Mon 3/15.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Contoso Partner Ops: send nightly feed with Office tenant GUID included (Asha, by EOD Thu 3/11).
- Redwood Engineering: implement tenant GUID matching and manual_claim flag in intake webhook (Karthik, by 3/18).
- Field GTM: Marcus to reach out to NorthStar and update HubSpot (Marcus, by 3/15).
- Vanessa: finalize workbook and publish PC_MAPPING_FINAL_20270310.xlsx to the shared drive and forward link.

Link to Partner Center referral example: https://partnercenter.microsoft.com/referrals/ABC123
HubSpot mapping: HubSpot:HS-987654

I'll follow up with the final workbook attached. Thanks everyone for moving quickly on this.

Best —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
